from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Knowledge_Query(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_knowledge_query"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("query_type",        "string", widget_type="text", default="stats")
        self.add_input("entity_id",         "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("entity_type",       "string", widget_type="text", default="asset")
        self.add_input("relationship_type", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("direction",         "string", widget_type="text", default="outbound")
        self.add_input("target_id",         "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("properties_json",   "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_output("ok",            "bool")
        self.add_output("entities",      "list")
        self.add_output("relationships", "list")
        self.add_output("paths",         "list")
        self.add_output("entity",        "any")
        self.add_output("stats",         "any")
        self.add_output("result_json",   "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        from src.runtime.knowledge_graph import get_knowledge_graph
        kg         = get_knowledge_graph()
        query_type = str(inputs.get("query_type", "stats")).strip().lower()
        _empty = {
            "exec_out": True, "ok": False, "entities": [], "relationships": [],
            "paths": [], "entity": None, "stats": {}, "result_json": "{}"
        }

        try:
            props_raw = inputs.get("properties_json") or "{}"
            try:
                props = json.loads(props_raw)
            except Exception:
                props = {}

            entity_id   = str(inputs.get("entity_id", "")).strip()
            entity_type = str(inputs.get("entity_type", "asset")).strip()
            rel_type    = str(inputs.get("relationship_type", "")).strip() or None
            direction   = str(inputs.get("direction", "outbound")).strip()
            target_id   = str(inputs.get("target_id", "")).strip()

            if query_type == "add_entity":
                if not entity_id:
                    _empty["result_json"] = json.dumps({"error": "entity_id required"})
                    return _empty
                kg.add_entity(entity_type, entity_id, props)
                entity = kg.get_entity(entity_id)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": True, "entities": [entity],
                    "relationships": [], "paths": [], "entity": entity,
                    "stats": kg.stats(),
                    "result_json": json.dumps({"action": "add_entity", "id": entity_id}),
                }

            elif query_type == "add_relationship":
                if not entity_id or not target_id or not rel_type:
                    _empty["result_json"] = json.dumps({"error": "entity_id, target_id, relationship_type required"})
                    return _empty
                rid = kg.add_relationship(entity_id, target_id, rel_type, props)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": True, "entities": [], "paths": [],
                    "relationships": [kg.get_relationship(rid)],
                    "entity": None, "stats": kg.stats(),
                    "result_json": json.dumps({"action": "add_relationship", "rel_id": rid}),
                }

            elif query_type == "entity":
                entity = kg.get_entity(entity_id)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": entity is not None, "entities": [entity] if entity else [],
                    "relationships": [], "paths": [],
                    "entity": entity, "stats": {},
                    "result_json": json.dumps(entity or {}),
                }

            elif query_type == "related":
                results = kg.query_related(entity_id, rel_type=rel_type, direction=direction)
                entities = [r["entity"] for r in results]
                rels     = [r["relationship"] for r in results]
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": True, "entities": entities,
                    "relationships": rels, "paths": [],
                    "entity": None, "stats": {},
                    "result_json": json.dumps({"entity_id": entity_id, "count": len(results)}),
                }

            elif query_type == "path":
                path = kg.find_path(entity_id, target_id)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": len(path) > 0, "entities": [],
                    "relationships": [], "paths": path,
                    "entity": None, "stats": {},
                    "result_json": json.dumps({"path": path, "found": len(path) > 0}),
                }

            else:  # stats
                stats = kg.stats()
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": True, "entities": kg.all_entities(),
                    "relationships": [], "paths": [],
                    "entity": None, "stats": stats,
                    "result_json": json.dumps(stats),
                }

        except Exception as exc:
            _empty["result_json"] = json.dumps({"error": str(exc)})
            return _empty

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Knowledge_Query
